integrity: The maximum, labeled count, and equivalence classification are certified by complete finite enumeration over the 27 possible columns and the full standard equivalence group. The correctness argument does not rely on solver optimality claims or random sampling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to three rows, alphabet size three, and strength three; it does not provide an asymptotic estimate for larger alphabets. Historical comparison sources with only year-level date metadata are not assigned invented day-level dates.
title: Exact classification of three-row ternary perfect hash families
